title: Skeleton Knight's Kiss
description: A skeletal knight in ornate armor and tattered cloak embraces and kisses a blue-skinned woman with flowing dark hair inside an oval frame. A vibrant red and orange bird flies above them releasing blue petals while the knight holds a glowing blue energy sword. The scene is set against a dark swirling vortex sky with dripping molten borders.
prompt: A skeletal knight in damaged bronze armor and grey cloak passionately kissing a beautiful blue-skinned woman with long flowing purple-black hair inside a large vertical oval frame. The knight holds a glowing blue energy sword. A bright red and orange phoenix-like bird flies above them scattering blue petals. Dramatic dark swirling vortex sky with fiery orange clouds and dripping molten borders framing the scene.
